Container.Name: olala-server
Container.Overview: Olala mini 7A1B (OVHcloud) served on the CPU by OVHcloud's modified llama.cpp. OpenAI-compatible API on /v1 (for Hermes, Open WebUI, etc.). The model (about 7 GB) is downloaded automatically into the models folder on first start.

Config.Name: API Port
Config.Description: OpenAI-compatible API. Address for clients: http://TOWER-IP:8090/v1

Config.Name: Models
Config.Description: Folder where the model is downloaded and kept

Config.Name: MODEL_FILE
Config.Description: Model file to use: q8_0-safe2 (6.9 GB, recommended on x86 CPUs) or q5_k_m (6.0 GB, lighter)

Config.Name: MODEL_REPO
Config.Description: Hugging Face repository the model is downloaded from

Config.Name: MODEL_ALIAS
Config.Description: Model name exposed by the API (use it as the model ID in Hermes)

Config.Name: THREADS
Config.Description: Number of CPU cores used by the model. Keep at least one core free for the server. For a hard limit as a safety net, also add --cpus=5 in Extra Parameters (Advanced View)

Config.Name: CTX_SIZE
Config.Description: Context size in tokens (32768 maximum for this model), shared between parallel requests

Config.Name: PARALLEL
Config.Description: Number of requests processed at the same time

Config.Name: REASONING_EFFORT
Config.Description: Default reasoning effort: disabled, low, medium or high (higher is slower on CPU)

Config.Name: API_KEY
Config.Description: Optional. If set, clients must send this key
